Main.Pool.Title: Share your games with the stats pool?
Main.Pool.What: After each Battlegrounds game Hearthpulse sends the heroes you were offered and the one you picked, your placement, solo or duos, your rating rounded to 500, the lobby's tribes and anomaly, your final board, your trinkets, the turns you leveled up, each fight's result, damage and predicted odds, every pick you make (Discover, triple rewards, trinkets) and the cards you play. Your Battlegrounds games from the last 30 days are sent once too. After each Ranked or Casual game: the cards each Discover, Adapt or Choose One card offered you, the one you took, the format and whether you won - not your deck, class, rank or opponent.
Main.Pool.Never: Never your name, BattleTag, account or anything about other players. Everyone's games build the hero, card, trinket and tribe lists and the Discover picks on the card pool panel. You can change this any time in Settings.
